failures.explanation: The agent correctly interpreted the task and changed ticket 101 and the assignee selection for ticket 102, but it used a different interaction strategy and clicked at x=1071 instead of the Save button for ticket 102. As a result, ticket 102 remained assigned to Sam in the persisted state; this was a skipped/incorrect save rather than an ambiguity in the task.

The agent pursued the correct interpretation but used keyboard typing into the select controls instead of selecting the intended options directly, then clicked inside row 102's assignee field rather than its Save button. As a result, ticket 102 remained assigned to Sam; this reflects a worse interaction strategy, not task ambiguity.
Infrastructure error before the agent acted (Not connected — call connect() first). Not an agent failure; excluded from pass estimates.
